findings: The particle/grain graphic anchored top-right of the hero is generic noise texture — the weakest, most templated element; it reads as a stock 'cosmic dust' fill rather than a considered composition partner.
The dark diagram boxes (plucked string, frequency list, Lissajous curve) are near-identical black rectangles that flatten mid-page rhythm into a repeated slab motif.
Several sections (the essay body columns, the epoch table) descend into dense uniform gray text walls where hierarchy softens and the eye has no re-entry point.
what_works: Hero is a decisive editorial move: left-aligned high-contrast serif with the italic 'walks' as a single punctuating gesture, set against asymmetric grain mass — not a centered floating headline.
Genuine typographic point of view: editorial serif display paired with all-caps mono utility labels and monospaced captions, the exact high/low voice pairing a template avoids.
Disciplined monochrome palette with a single restrained rust accent used for emphasis (highlighted row, 'walks'), never as garnish.
The 'Sounding Log' with the oversized '119' numeral and structured experiment/epoch tables is a signature system-of-record device with real editorial conviction.
A.reasoning: This is an intentional, dense editorial artifact — dark monochrome with a rust accent, an asymmetric serif hero with a single italic punctuation, and a serif-vs-mono voice pairing that no default generator reaches for. It avoids every cardinal slop state: no centered gradient hero, no three-card grid, no default sans. It loses points only where mid-page diagram slabs repeat and body columns thicken into uniform gray, but the decisive aesthetic moves clear the threshold.

findings: Hero typography uses a clear editorial serif with strong weight contrast against body text
Interactive figure blocks maintain consistent left-aligned captions and small black-and-white thumbnails without decorative borders
Color restricted to off-white background, near-black text, and single red accent for section labels
Desktop layout avoids centered symmetry; text blocks sit left with generous right margins and embedded canvases breaking vertical flow
what_works: Opening three-line stanza establishes immediate focal hierarchy and tonal voice before any navigation or secondary content appears
Each Chladni figure pairs a precise frequency label with a one-sentence functional description, creating rhythmic micro-hierarchy across six entries
B.reasoning: The desktop render shows a deliberate editorial composition built around poetic opening text, restrained red accents, and integrated interactive plates rather than any template SaaS pattern. Type and spacing follow consistent rhythmic steps; no gradients, glows, or symmetrical card grids appear. Minor deductions for occasional tight vertical gaps between long prose blocks and the final log section, but no cardinal slop states are present.
